title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass, Retro Wave Collection Traditional Style Allied Brass
description:
Add functional storage with a wall mount paper towel holder crafted from solid brass—ideal for keeping paper towels handy while reducing countertop clutter.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted paper towel holder (wall mount paper towel rack / paper towel dispenser style) for easy access
- Solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Traditional bathroom hardware look that also suits vintage bath accessories and classic bath accessories spaces
- Designed to coordinate with the retro wave collection for a matching retro wave set
- Offered in a wide range of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Collection: Retro Wave
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 15-Inch height x 2.25-Inch width x 4-Inch length; 5-Inch projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: False
- Included items: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
